# openobserve_function (Data Source)

Reads an existing transform function, including which pipelines use it.

`used_by` is what answers "why can I not delete this function": the server refuses to remove one that a pipeline still references.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openobserve_function" "redact" {
  name = "redact_email"
}

# Which pipelines hold this function. This answers "why can I not delete it":
# the server refuses to remove a function that is still referenced.
output "used_by" {
  value = data.openobserve_function.redact.used_by
}

output "safe_to_delete" {
  value = data.openobserve_function.redact.used_by_count == 0
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Function name to look up.

### Optional

- `org_id` (String) Organization identifier. Defaults to the provider's `org_id`.

### Read-Only

- `function` (String) The stored function body, including the trailing return expression the server appends to VRL.
- `id` (String) Data source ID in the format `{org_id}/{name}`.
- `language` (String) `vrl` or `js`.
- `num_args` (Number) Number of parameters.
- `params` (String) Comma-separated parameter names.
- `used_by` (List of String) Names of the pipelines that use this function.
- `used_by_count` (Number) How many pipelines use it. Non-zero means a delete will be refused.
